VERDICT: ShuntFormer-4 led the reimplemented spike-driven attention controls in this suite. It reached 99.0% accuracy on synthetic associative recall, against at most 18.4% for the compared prior mechanisms. Its enwik8 validation loss was 3.28 bits per byte, against 3.41 for Spikformer SSA and 3.50 for WTA. It reached 73.4% on CIFAR-10, against 67.2% for Spikformer SSA and 66.2% for SDSA. The conventional ANN control reached 2.65 bits per byte and 78.9%.
RECALL_TEXT: Every prior spike-driven attention stays at the level of guessing a value from the context, on every seed. That covers Spikformer SSA, SSA divided by the number of keys, SDSA and both WTA variants, and it holds at 4,000 steps too. ShuntFormer-4 solves the task on all three seeds and binary ShuntFormer on two. The ablations show which part matters. Without the shunting normalisation, CSA stays at chance on every seed. Without competition (score-weighted selection, still normalised per query) it learns more slowly: one seed in three at 2,000 steps, all three at 4,000. Dividing by the same constant for every query (SSA ÷ #keys) does not help, so it is the per-query division by total excitation that matters.
LM_TEXT: Every tested spike-driven variant trained stably from scratch in this causal setting. ShuntFormer-4 has the lowest spike-driven loss at every evaluation point. Graded attention spikes close about 40% of the gap between binary CSA and softmax over spikes. The arithmetic model estimates 0.42 µJ per token for ShuntFormer-4 at a 17% firing rate, against 4.37 µJ for the ANN.
VISION_TEXT: ShuntFormer reaches 73.3% after 5 epochs, against 67.2% for Spikformer SSA and 66.2% for SDSA trained identically. It passes Spikformer's final accuracy after 3 of the 5 epochs. ShuntFormer-4 reaches 73.4% and the ANN reaches 78.9%. The operation-count estimates per image are 16.8 µJ for ShuntFormer, 16.7 µJ for SDSA, 17.2 µJ for ShuntFormer-4 and 197 µJ for the ANN.
SAMPLE_TEXT: The ANN reached 3.5 bits per byte after 1.44M training tokens on enwik8. Softmax over spikes reached it at 2.42M, ShuntFormer-4 at 2.73M and Spikformer SSA at 4.30M. WTA and SDSA finished the 6.1M-token budget above that loss. On CIFAR-10, ShuntFormer passed Spikformer's final accuracy after 60% of training.
